atlasA:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: sprite atlas of decorative world props for a cute mobile isometric train puzzle.
Primary request: Create ONE atlas, exactly 1536 x 768 pixels if supported, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, with exactly eight distinct isolated decorative prop sprites arranged in an invisible, perfectly regular 4-column by 2-row grid of equal square 384 x 384 cells.
Input image: provided atlas is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its polished rounded toy diorama rendering, softly beveled modeled details, gentle material texture and clear dimensional silhouettes. DO NOT copy its props, layout, backdrop, transparency artifacts or ground platforms.
Scene/backdrop: SOLID PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background. Intentionally fully opaque white, absolutely uniform white across the canvas and all gutters. This is NOT transparent. No checkerboard, gray background, colored backdrop, gradients, texture or visible grid.
Composition: each sprite centered horizontally in its own cell, fully contained with at least 12% clear white padding on every side. Within each row, place every sprite's lowest physical ground-contact point on the same baseline, 86% down its cell. Keep generous blank white gutters and no overlaps. Keep all eight sprites separately crop-ready. Use a fixed 30-degree elevated isometric camera and consistent orientation, no perspective convergence.
Row 1, from left to right, DESERT:
1. One rounded green cactus with two short arms and one tiny peach-colored bloom.
2. A compact cluster of terraced warm sandstone boulders with rounded horizontal stepped layers.
3. One cute short palm tree with thick gently curving trunk and a compact rounded canopy.
4. One small terracotta station house, cozy simple miniature, warm terracotta walls and roof, one doorway and a little window; no signs or platform.
Row 2, from left to right, SNOWY FOREST:
1. One snow-covered spruce with layered dark teal-green rounded branches and generous soft white snow caps.
2. A compact group of low snow-capped gray-blue rocks.
3. One cozy small snowy wooden cabin with simple brown log walls, snow on roof, one warm window and a little door.
4. One short snow-covered shrub, rounded blue-green foliage under soft snow mounds.
Style/medium: premium softly modeled 3D toy diorama artwork, rounded forms, soft top-left illumination, restrained detail, charming compact proportions, crisp readable silhouettes at 45-75px rendered size. Each object must look like an individual game prop, not a scene.
Constraints: no shadows beyond an extremely faint soft local contact tint directly under each object. No ground rectangles, terrain tiles, soil islands, platforms, environment, extra scattered decoration, floating particles, labels, numbers, text, UI, borders, grid lines or watermark. Do not add checkerboard under any circumstances. White areas are literally opaque RGB 255,255,255.
